knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An unidentified agent and an unknown glove cannot be shown to protect the worker. The learner refuses, asks for the SDS and approved PPE, and records the request.
A possible exposure is stopped at once. The learner leaves the source, tells the supervisor and follows the emergency route, without waiting for symptoms to pass.
Contaminated PPE is removed and stored in the work area, so it does not travel to the break room or home.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the emergency route, first-aid contact, eyewash and first-aid kit on a fictional site brief before starting.
Refuses a simulated unidentified agent and an unknown glove, and requests the SDS and the PPE it names.
Selects PPE from a sample SDS, and states that the higher controls were checked first.
Completes a simulated exposure concern record with time, product, symptoms, first aid given and people informed, and stops the task.
Places contaminated PPE in the designated work-area store in the simulation.
passRule: All five practical criteria observed as met in a desk or tabletop exercise. The knowledge check result is not a practical pass, and this assessment is not a health or safety certificate.
evidenceRequired: Annotated fictional site brief showing the emergency route and first-aid contacts
Sample SDS annotation showing the PPE selected
Completed exposure concern record for the simulated event
Assessor observation note for each practical criterion
stopWorkCriteria: Unidentified agent or unknown glove used
Possible exposure not escalated, or work resumed before the supervisor confirmed the area
Contaminated PPE worn or carried outside the work area
Higher controls skipped and PPE used as the only control without justification
